details: The US Treasury Department has initiated "Operation Economic Outcast," a comprehensive campaign to isolate Iran by targeting its financial lifelines. This includes sanctions across aviation, shipping, gold, technology, and explicitly digital assets. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated the goal is to sever every economic lifeline until Tehran stands alone, intensifying pressure amid ongoing regional tensions. The move carries implications for global economic stability and could increase regulatory scrutiny on digital asset transactions.
title: US Launches "Operation Economic Outcast" Against Iran, Sanctioning Digital Assets

details: Bitcoin has climbed above $80,000 for the first time since May, reaching a three-month high. This rally, mirrored by gold also hitting a three-month peak, is attributed to ongoing conflict in the Middle East and broader political uncertainty, alongside a weakening US dollar. Investors are increasingly turning to safe-haven assets in response to global instability and concerns surrounding US fiscal policies.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $80,000 Amid Geopolitical Uncertainty

details: The trade conflict between the United States and Canada has intensified following the US imposition of new 50% tariffs on Canadian goods, including crucial sectors like cars, trucks, and steel. In retaliation, Canada announced counter-tariffs on over 700 American products, valued at nearly $20 billion. This escalation is expected to disrupt global supply chains, increase manufacturing costs, and contribute to broader economic uncertainty in North America and beyond.
title: US-Canada Trade War Escalates with New Tariffs
